decisions.reason: As a close-to-core custom hearing product in a growing market, it fits the firm's established capabilities and likely stays on the market despite only modest public visibility.
Management has publicly committed to this branded earmold on its own webpage and, given its strong fit with the firm's hearing-systems business, is likely to continue backing it.
The thermoforming unit is close to the firm's equipment offering and supports workflow efficiency, so prior development effort and strategic fit make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
